raw_tokens.value: Warpriest Bonus Feat ~ Twin Thunders Flurry
1,[PREABILITY:2,CATEGORY=FEAT,Improved Two-Weapon Fighting,Two-Weapon Fighting],[PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Flurry of Blows]
Your dual bludgeoning strikes are especially deadly when you are fighting giants.

You can trip a creature with the giant subtype of up to Huge size, and you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls against creatures of the giant subtype. Further, each time you hit a creature of the giant subtype with your offhand weapon after you hit that creature with your primary weapon, you can deal the extra off-hand weapon damage Twin Thunders grants you.
